manifest_purpose: Human-reviewed recipe dispositions and exact material-purpose contracts kept outside compiler-owned chemistry authority output.
review_scope: This human-reviewed ledger records only the exact approved and rejected cohorts named below. Every other authored transformation remains pending reaction-level balance and behavioral review; presence in source is not approval.

approved_recipe_contracts.fixed_mass_packet_basis: One gaseous formula-unit packet is 250 mB.
approved_recipe_contracts.exact_material_purpose: Consume a bounded carbon-monoxide gas stream by complete oxidation into carbon dioxide inside PNCR containment; this is a specific toxic/combustible-gas treatment sink, not a generic molecule conversion or graph-adjacency route.
approved_recipe_contracts.industrial_authority_finding: PNCR owns this deliberate contained gas reaction; the route forms no elemental metal and does not overlap TConstruct metal formation.
approved_recipe_contracts.gas_destination_contract: The two carbon-dioxide packets remain a PNCR fluid output for contained downstream handling.
approved_recipe_contracts.required_runtime_oracle: Fresh capture must prove exact recipe registration, 500 mB CO plus 250 mB O2 consumption, 500 mB CO2 delivery to a contained destination, and the uncontained escape behavior at the gas boundary.

rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: The retained snapshot registered six exact IDs; the guarded copper source attempt was also removed so a future registry change cannot silently add a seventh unreviewed route.

rejected_recipe_families.exact_material_purpose: Leach named carbonate feedstocks into sulfate, nitrate, or chloride salts and extract beryllium chloride from beryl.
rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: one opaque acid-fluid packet and one opaque mineral item became one salt item without a common fixed-mass basis; seven carbonate routes returned carbon dioxide only at 20 percent chance, while the beryl route did not account for aluminum, silicon, oxygen, or hydrogen residues.
rejected_recipe_families.residue_finding: Rejected: the carbonate carbon and acid hydrogen were not deterministically delivered to named products, and the beryl gangue disappeared entirely.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Open heated Create leaching is a permissible process class, but each retained route lacks the material-specific stoichiometry and complete residue contract required for that authority.
rejected_recipe_families.gas_destination_contract: Any corrected carbonate-acid route must deterministically account for carbon-dioxide production and declare contained delivery or uncontained escape behavior; no gas behavior is approved here.
